_comment: Face-match calibration tables (FPR, TAR, cosine similarity) for ArcFace w600k_r50, as Windows Hello's per-hardware-model tables (F51, F60). FPR is the false-accept rate of one print comparison; linux_hello multiplies it by the comparisons of one attempt and accepts below 1e-5. Keys of `cameras` are the USB VID:PID of the IR camera; `default` names the table for unknown cameras. See docs/calibration.md.

lfw_gray.source: grayscale LFW, label noise removed (scripts/calibrate.py, 87,079,562 impostor and 242,125 genuine pairs); FPR measured up to 0.400, tail fit from 0.425 on, 0.500 = per-attempt bound 1e-5 / 240
